title_zh: 黑龙江省政协常委康翰卿被查
title_en: Kang Hanqing, Member of Heilongjiang Provincial CPPCC Standing Committee, Under Investigation
summary_zh: 黑龙江省纪委监委通报，黑龙江省政协常委、提案委员会主任康翰卿涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: The Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission announced that Kang Hanqing, a member of the provincial CPPCC Standing Committee, is under investigation for serious violations of discipline and law.
body_zh: 新京报讯 据黑龙江省纪委监委消息：黑龙江省政协常委、提案委员会主任康翰卿涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受黑龙江省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
